description:
Run an electrical rule check (ERC) on a schematic and return structured diagnostics — the KiCad ERC step, over MCP.

CHECKS: duplicate reference designators; net endpoints naming an unknown component or pin; unconnected pins (ignoring hidden power pins and explicit no-connects); single-pin nets; driver conflicts (two outputs on one net); power_in pins with no power_out source; input pins with no driver; no-connect markers on connected or non-existent pins; incomplete differential pairs; empty nets.

INPUT: `schematic` (same shape as netlist_export), `ignore` (optional array of rule codes to suppress, e.g. ["erc.net-single-pin"]), `treatUnspecifiedAsPassive` (optional; when true an "unspecified" pin counts as passive for the input-not-driven check).

OUTPUT: { ok, counts: { error, warn, info }, diagnostics: [{ code, severity, message, hint?, locus: { component?, pin?, net? }, nextAction? }], checked: { components, nets, pins } }. `ok` is true when there are zero errors. Diagnostics use the same shape as kernelCAD geometry diagnostics, sorted error → warn → info, deterministically.

footprint.description: Footprint id from the footprint library, e.g. "Package_SO:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm".

pins.description: Pins declared by the library part. A component with no pins cannot appear in a netlist.

hiddenPower.description: True for a hidden power pin implicitly connected by the symbol. ERC does not report it unconnected.

pinType.description: Electrical type (KiCad pin electrical types). Defaults to "unspecified".

reference.description: Reference designator, e.g. "R1", "U3", "J2". Must be unique.

diffPairPartner.description: The other member of this differential pair, when declared.

endpoints.description: Pins electrically common on this net.

name.description: Net name. Repeating a name merges the nets (net labels on several sheets).

noConnects.description: Explicit no-connect markers — pins deliberately left unused.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason carried from the schematic.

title.description: Optional schematic title, used in diagnostics context.

treatUnspecifiedAsPassive.description: When true, an "unspecified" pin counts as passive for the input-not-driven check.

name: erc_run
title: Run Electrical Rule Check
